cards.title: One crow, eight flat looks
cards.text: The same crow in eight flat looks, closer together this time. Tick any you like, even only part of one.
cards.why: Last round's eight were too far out, so these all stay flat and simple and differ in smaller ways: body shape, eyes, beak, shading and the shade of black. The look you pick sets how every character in the app gets drawn.
cards.details:
One crow, drawn eight ways, all flat: flat colours, simple shapes, at most a shade or two, nothing airbrushed, no outlines, no glow. It's the same bird in the same pose in all eight: turned a little to the right, so the beak points right, the near eye sits left of the beak, the far eye just peeks over the beak past the edge of the head, and you see the chest and a little of its left side. None has a mouth.

What changes is smaller this time, a few things per look rather than everything at once: the body's shape (round, tall, compact, long-tailed), soft curves or crisp corners, the legs and wing, the eye, the beak, how much shading (none, one shade, or one shade with a thin edge of light), and which black: blue-black, purple-black, grey and black, green-black, slate, brown-black, charcoal, plain black.

1 Plump. Round and soft, no neck, short thick legs. Blue-black with one shade. Dark round eyes with a white glint, the top cut level by a lid.

2 Sleek. Long and elegant: a slim body on a long neck, a long beak and tail, long legs. Purple-black with one shade and a thin gold edge of light along the top. Half-closed almond eyes with a pale silver iris. This is the one that takes most from Stilt, which you slightly liked: its build, its knowing eyes and its edge of light. It has solid legs instead of thin lines, a fuller body, and the edge only where light would fall.

3 Hooded. Compact and sturdy. Coloured like a hooded crow, a real kind of crow: grey body, black head, bib, wings and tail. No shading at all: the two colours do the work. Pale cream ring eyes under a lid.

4 Crisp. Built from straight edges with the corners only just softened. Green-black, the wing a deep sheen green, with one shade cut straight down the front. A sharp wedge of a beak and sharp toes. Angular eyes with a dark iris and a straight lid.

5 Longtail. Smooth: a teardrop of a body, a small round head, and a long tail that reaches nearly to the floor. Slate black with a blue sheen on the wing and tail, one shade and a thin cool edge of light. That edge is the only thing it takes from Stilt. A pale iris round a small pupil, under a softly curved lid.

6 Ruff. Big and heavy, like a raven: a big flat head, a deep arched beak, shaggy throat feathers and a pointed tail. Brown-black with one shade. Strong legs and clawed toes. Dark brown eyes under a level lid.

7 Bean. Built from simple capsules, in the family of the round 4 animals you kept: a capsule body leaning forward, a round head, a capsule wing, stubby legs and rounded feet. Charcoal with one broad shade down the right side. White eyes with a dark pupil and a lid a third of the way down.

8 Ink. One flat black and nothing else, like a printed sign: smooth curves that end in sharp points, the wing marked only by a thin blue line, the legs single thin lines. White half-moon eyes, flat along the top.

The first picture on the front shows all eight at the size they'd stand in your room, at one scale, so a small look stands shorter. The second shows each one small, the size of an icon, since a look has to still read when it's that small. Tap a picture in the grid to see one large.

My pick is 5, Longtail. It's drawn the way the rest of the app already is, a base colour with a shade on the lower right and a little light on the upper left, so it sits with the room's trophy and globe. The long tail and the blue sheen on the wing make it read as a crow at a glance, and the pale eye under a soft lid gives a calm, slightly knowing look with no mouth needed. It keeps the one part of Stilt that would suit every character, the thin edge of light, and leaves the rest. The same way of drawing works for a person or any animal. My second is 3, Hooded. It's the clearest of the eight when small, and two flat colours with no shading would be the easiest to keep tidy across a whole cast, but it makes your avatar grey rather than black.

Still weak: Plump, Ruff and Bean are dark on the dark blue wall and go muddy at icon size, where their eyes are the only thing that shows. Crisp's dark side runs into its dark body, and its eye can read a touch stern. Ink's flat-topped eyes can read bored rather than calm. Ruff's ragged throat and wing tips make it the busiest drawing here, and the throat could read as a beard. Bean is the most toy-like and the least like a real crow. Sleek is still the closest to Stilt, so it's the one nearest to what you said not to repeat. Longtail's tail is long enough that it needs a wide spot in the room, and its pale eye can look a little intense.
